name: Is laminate flooring suitable for kitchens and bathrooms?

mainEntity.name: Is laminate flooring suitable for kitchens and bathrooms?

acceptedAnswer.text: While traditional laminate flooring is not ideal for areas with high moisture like full bathrooms or laundries due to its wood-fiber core being susceptible to water damage, advancements in technology have introduced water-resistant and even waterproof laminate options. These specialized products feature enhanced core materials and tighter locking systems that prevent moisture penetration, making them suitable for kitchens and half-baths where spills are common. Always check the manufacturer's specifications for moisture resistance when considering laminate for these environments to ensure it meets your needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Traditional laminate isn't ideal for wet areas, but water-resistant and waterproof laminate options are suitable for kitchens and half-baths.
